description: The Describable Textures Dataset (DTD) is a texture dataset containing 5640 images sourced from Flickr in 47 texture categories such as polka-dotted, scaly, and striped. It is used as a reference dataset for evaluating texture quality and diversity in computer vision and machine learning research.
